name: Crustless Bacon & Gruyere Quiche
ingredients_verbatim: 3/4 cup half and half (or whole milk)
why: Egg-and-cheese-identity crustless quiche (the bake IS the dish, bacon is a component). Published 416 cal / 4g carbs / 24g protein clears the 400-650 cal, <=35g carb band on the source's own numbers. Naturally low-carb (no crust, no starch base). NOTE: 416 cal sits near the floor - moderate confidence it stays >=400 after our label-DB recompute; protein 24g is just shy of the 25g ideal but is a high protein-to-cal ratio. Gruyere has no board home (flagged) - deliberately kept per the pricer-lane exercise; substitutes cleanly to shredded-cheese if the selector prefers.
